work.title: A Sequel to the First Six Books of the Elements of Euclid
work.subtitle: Containing an Easy Introduction to Modern Geometry, with Numerous Examples
work.author: John Casey, LL.D., F.R.S.

primary_witness.folio_offset_law: PDF Folio = Printed Body Page + 26 (pp. 1–248 <-> folios 0027–0274)

collated_sixth_edition.notes: Posthumous printing seen through the press by Casey's son-in-law Patrick A. E. Dowling after Casey's death on 3 January 1891, preserving the 5th-edition six-book and Supplementary Chapter architecture (8 sections on Recent Elementary Geometry).

units.title: Books I, II & IV Extensions — Concurrency, Euler Line, Nine-Points Circle, Medians & Mean Centres
Book III & Book VI Sec. V Extensions — Power of a Point, Orthogonal Circles, Radical Axis & Coaxal Systems
Book VI Extensions, Part A (Sec. I–III & VI) — Ceva & Menelaus, Similitude, Harmonic & Anharmonic Section
Book VI Extensions, Part B (Sec. IV & VII) — Inversion, Casey's Theorem, Feuerbach's Theorem & Poles and Polars
Supplementary Chapter, Sec. I & III (Part 1) — Isogonal Conjugates, Antiparallels, Symmedians & Lemoine's Circles
Supplementary Chapter, Sec. II–VII & Exercises — Similar Figures, Brocard Geometry, Tucker/Taylor Circles & Associated Figures
